exercises.hint: INSERT = push() a new student object, then check the length.
exercises.task: This SQL adds a row: INSERT INTO students (name, program, gpa) VALUES ('Zainab', 'Data Science', 3.4). Simulate it with push() and print the new count.

exercises.hint: UPDATE = map() that changes only the matching object — spread the old one and override gpa.
exercises.task: This SQL changes one row: UPDATE students SET gpa = 2.9 WHERE id = 6. Simulate it with map() and print Noah's updated row.

exercises.hint: DELETE = filter() keeping the rows that stay — the survivors are the opposite of the WHERE.
exercises.task: This SQL removes rows: DELETE FROM students WHERE gpa < 3.0. Simulate it with filter() and print the surviving names.
